items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Mundell Lowe left he says, “I’ve got a great guitar player for him, but he doesn’t have any hair.”

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. We had a good band, good guys in the bands though. And he wanted all- star bands, he did. Mundell Lowe left he says, “I’ve got a great guitar player for him, but he doesn’t have any hair.” He wants all young looking guys. So Danny Stiles says, “this guy’s the best.” He brought him the Down Beat polls, and he says, “Well this guy won all the polls, let me see what he looks like.” He brought him in it was Jim Hall. And he says, “Here’s our new guitar, Jim Hall, come on out here, let’s do a tune.” So…

dissatisfied or said that he was dissatisfied with him. “You come to me when you’ve got something to ask me, man. Don’t ask somebody else.” That’s how he was. He was very good at that. Very good at that. Now don’t fool with him, because he’ll chop your head off. But he’d stick right by you you know. If he’s your enemy you’d better leave, you’d better leave. No use hanging around.
